instruction: Could you add a layer to this image and give it the name 'Polygon'?

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new layer in GIMP and naming it 'Polygon'. The evaluator checks the GIMP config file to verify the layer-new-name is set to 'Polygon'.
metadata.verification: Uses existing check_config_status metric with layer name 'Polygon'.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Evaluator checks wrong state - it verifies the 'layer-new-name' preference in gimprc config file, which is just a default name template setting, NOT the actual layer that was created in the image
CRITICAL: Does not verify that a layer was actually added to the image - only checks if a preference was set
CRITICAL: Does not verify the layer exists in the image file (white_background.xcf) - the config preference can be set without any layer being created
MAJOR: Incomplete coverage - instruction requires (1) add a layer AND (2) name it 'Polygon', but evaluator only checks a preference setting, not actual layer existence
MAJOR: State timing issue - postconfig closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) without saving the file first, so any created layer may be lost and not persisted to the .xcf file
MAJOR: Wrong verification approach - should parse the XCF file structure or use GIMP scripting to query actual layers, not check a user preference setting
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace the verification approach: Instead of checking gimprc config, parse the actual .xcf file at /home/user/Desktop/white_background.xcf to extract layer information
Add postconfig to save the file before closing: Add Ctrl+S command before Ctrl+Q to ensure the layer is persisted
Create a new getter function to extract layer names from the XCF file (e.g., get_gimp_layers_from_xcf) that parses the file structure or uses GIMP scripting
Create a new metric function to check if a specific layer name exists in the layer list (e.g., check_layer_exists)
Alternative approach: Use GIMP's Python-Fu scripting to query the image's layer structure before closing GIMP
